headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra with expanded multimodal capabilities
body: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, marking a significant capability expansion in large language models with enhanced multimodal performance. For healthcare AI, this advancement matters because improved model architectures directly influence clinical decision support systems, documentation automation, and diagnostic assistance tools that depend on accurate reasoning across text and imaging data. The velocity and attention from 16 unique authors signals the market is closely watching how these foundation model improvements translate into healthcare applications, from EHR integration to regulatory compliance use cases. Healthcare organizations and AI vendors will need to evaluate whether Astra's benchmarked improvements reduce hallucination rates and improve reliability in clinical workflows where accuracy directly impacts patient safety and reimbursement.
